intro: One scoop of daging masak kicap is roughly 300 kcal. The calories come from the beef, the cooking oil and the sugary kicap manis.

variants.name: Beef fried first, then cooked in kicap

diet: Yes, this is one of the easier dishes to fit into a weight loss plan. Beef gives you protein that keeps you full longer. What to watch is the sweet, oily kicap gravy. Take one scoop, a little gravy, and add veggies.
tips: Take the meat first. One spoon of kicap gravy is enough to wet your rice.
Cooking at home? Mix kicap masin with a little kicap manis to cut the sugar.
No need to fry the beef first. Just sauté and simmer to save oil.

swap.name: Less-oil black pepper beef
swap.why: Still full of flavour but less sugar than kicap manis, and the protein stays high.

faq.q: How do I make daging masak kicap tender?
faq.a: Slice thinly against the grain, or simmer longer on low heat. Marinating with a bit of ginger also helps.

faq.q: Is kicap manis high in sugar?
faq.a: Yes, kicap manis has a lot of sugar. One tablespoon can have around 10 g of sugar, so use just enough.

faq.q: Can I use frozen beef for masak kicap?
faq.a: Yes. Thaw it in the fridge overnight and pat it dry with tissue before cooking so it doesn't get watery.
